title: LP2-49–51: fixed bit-grid barcode scan
question: Does the pinned 64-bit-wide grid rendering, whole or separated by manuscript page, decode as a QR Code or Data Matrix under fixed planar transformations?
summary: No QR Code or Data Matrix payload decoded in 64 fixed-grid scans; the same decoder read both generated positive controls.

scope.representation: Pinned wiki transcription, declared base-60 byte mapping, eight most-significant-first bits per entry; 64 bits per manuscript row, with all 32 rows or the three original page groups.
scope.procedure: Scan each of four bit canvases under eight D4 rotations/reflections and two color polarities with zxing-cpp restricted to QR Code and Data Matrix; verify generated positives and scan fixed-seed bit shuffles.
scope.parameters: Four canvases times 16 transforms = 64 original scans; eight shuffles per canvas times 16 transforms = 512 comparison scans; bit scale 8 pixels, white quiet zone four modules; zxing-cpp 3.1.1 with rotate, invert and downscale retries disabled.
scope.exclusions: Other glyph readings, alphabets, bases, bit orders, grid widths, cropping, padding, inserted finder patterns, page permutations, altered decoder settings, other barcode formats and encrypted payloads without a valid barcode wrapper.

finding: Zero valid nonempty decodes across the 64 declared manuscript scans; zero across 512 matched bit-shuffle scans. Both generated positive controls decoded exactly.
limitations: The supplied historical report lacks its final plot images and full settings, so this is a new fixed variant, not an exact replay of all reported images. Zero decodes is conditional on the transcription, layout, search space and zxing-cpp settings; shuffled bitmaps do not provide a post-selection probability.
next_steps: Only expand the barcode search with a prespecified change to glyphs, grid geometry or decoder rule; preserve every attempted candidate and validate any hit as a full payload.

variant.label: Baseline: fixed manuscript-row rendering, page slices and planar transforms

review.reviewer: Codex — fixed-rule decoder scan, independently rebuilt source bits and positive controls

reproduction.environment: Python 3 with zxing-cpp==3.1.1 and numpy; local pinned inputs only, no network or AI calls during replay.

visuals.caption: Four fixed manuscript-width bit canvases; none decoded under sixteen declared planar and polarity transformations.
